name: Terpsi Chat (schema exploration)
description: A SQLite schema and its gates for messaging between under-18s in a youth-arts organisation. Adults and minors are separate tables, so a channel table's foreign keys decide who may appear in it: peer channels hold ciphertext with no plaintext column, staff channels require a witness who is not the sender so a private adult-minor channel has no representable form, and guardian visibility is a view over structure that never touches message content. A design exploration with working enforcement, not an implementation — most of it is superseded by rudi193-cmd/terpsi-music's lane model, and README.md carries the per-mechanism table saying which parts to take.
author: USER
network: none. Stdlib only, no sockets, no HTTP client. The only database is created in memory by the test suite; nothing is written to disk and nothing is persisted between runs, which is why data_streams is empty rather than describing a store.

notes.not_an_implementation: There is no client, no transport, no key custody and no device here. The gates cover a schema, which is the easy half of a messaging system. Anything device-side has, in practice, never executed.
notes.superseded_in_named_parts: README.md carries a per-mechanism table. The live contribution is the witness constraint on adult-to-minor channels; guardian_links is defective and must not be ported, because it conflates standing with reachability and cannot express a contact restriction that does not end guardianship. The consuming repo separates those in records/sending.py.
notes.why_it_is_in_the_store: It was built in rudi193-cmd/quick-stupids, which by that repo's first rule can never be a dependency of anything. Landing it here is what makes its live parts importable when terpsi-music builds a messaging capability.
notes.sqlite_pragma_hazard: Several guarantees are foreign keys, and SQLite enforces those only under PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON, per connection, off by default. The pragma cannot be bound to a schema. test_fk_pragma_is_the_whole_ballgame demonstrates the unenforced case accepting an orphan row; a consuming implementation on Postgres has no equivalent hazard.
notes.mutation_harness: 22 schema mutations plus 2 on the notify module, each removing one mechanism and requiring the gate that claims to cover it to fail, with a control proving the unmutated schema passes. Building it caught three gates passing for the wrong reason — a neighbouring constraint satisfying the assertion — which is the failure shape terpsi-music's §7 already names.
notes.provenance: Every empirical and legal claim in docs/DESIGN.md is marked assumed. Outbound egress was blocked in the session that wrote it, no primary source was retrieved, and no figure was invented to fill the gap.
notes.no_score_no_content_access: Guardian visibility is structure only — edges, counts, timing — by a view that cannot reach ciphertext. There is no code path by which a guardian reads a message, and the young person sees whatever the guardian sees, including that they looked.
